time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*24)
pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin = top-left corner of the full 2160x1080 frame; all values in pixels
duplicate_frames: frame 1 is pixel-identical to frame 0 (mean abs diff 0.01): nothing moves between frames 0 and 1; real motion starts between frames 1 and 2

camera.motion: static (phase correlation on a static traffic light: max shift 0.01 px over all 72 frames); no pan, no zoom, no shake
camera.focal_length: unknown (not estimated here; use depth_info + a known size, or the vanishing point / horizon below)
camera.horizon_note: horizon ~118 px above the image centre row -> camera pitched slightly down; vanishing point ~173 px right of the image centre column -> camera yawed slightly left of the main-road direction
camera.cross_street: runs left-right across the view; its far curb is near-horizontal at y ~594 (x=100), 598 (x=500), 606 (x=1700), 608 (x=2100) -> image rows are (nearly) lines of constant depth on the ground there; van and cyclist travel along it at nearly constant image y
camera.ground_plane: flat road; ground-contact rows (larger y = closer to camera): BMW 589, van 640-646, cyclist 650, taxi 665 (frame 0) -> 848 (frame 71), pedestrian feet 777 -> 808, Mercedes tyres 826

taxi.description: yellow (pale cream-yellow) sedan taxi with roof sign 'TAXI', Ford Crown Victoria style; the only yellow object
taxi.motion_summary: starts in the cross street left of centre, seen side-on moving right (image dx ~ +10 px/frame); turns towards the camera between ~frame 18 and ~44 (side view -> 3/4 view -> front view); image x of the box centre peaks at frame 41 (~819) then drifts slowly left while it approaches the camera (box grows, ground row 665 -> 848)
taxi.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centre of the bounding box (x0..x1, y0..y1 with y1 = tyre-contact row). bottom_center_x + ground_y = ground point under the car; mask_cx/cy = mask centroid
taxi.pixel_size: side view frames 0-12: length (bumper to bumper) 468-493 px, height (roof-sign top to tyre contact) 118-146 px; front view frame 44: width 228 px, height 198 px; frame 71: width 393 px, height 263 px
taxi.occlusion: in front of everything it overlaps (van, cyclist); a traffic-light pole (x~445-455) crosses it in frames 0-20; it never leaves the frame

van.description: white full-size cargo van (Chevrolet Express style) with brown/copper side windows, seen side-on, travelling left-to-right along the cross street behind the taxi
van.visible_frames: 0-71 (all; front reaches x~2031 at frame 71, still inside the frame)
van.motion_summary: starts from rest (frame 1->2 shift 1 px) and accelerates steadily to the right all clip long (image dx ~1 px/frame at frame 2, ~10 at 20, ~20 at 40, ~33 at 60, ~38-40 at 70-71); vertical position constant (roof row 471-477)
van.reference_point: ref_x = centre of bbox (x0 = rear bumper, x1 = front bumper), ref_y = middle between roof and wheel-contact row. rear_edge_row520 = the most reliable per-frame position measure (rear body edge at image row 520)
van.pixel_size: length 459 px (frames 0-6), 447-451 px (frames 36-46), 462 (66) -> 479 px (70-71) (perspective: longer when far off the image centre); height roof->tyre contact 167-173 px (median 169)
van.occlusion: lower body/wheels behind the taxi frames 0-47; passes in front of the parked BMW ~frames 38-59; its wheels go behind the Mercedes roof ~frames 54-66; the cyclist rides in front of its side frames ~55-71; static traffic-light pole x~1905 in front at the end

cyclist.motion_summary: constant rightward image speed ~17.2-18.6 px/frame (slightly increasing), image y constant (head top ~512, tyre contact ~650)
cyclist.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centre of the rider+bike bounding box
cyclist.pixel_size: bike+rider box 135 px long (rear tyre to front tyre) x 138 px tall (head top to tyre contact), measured frames 29-38 (135-136 x 137-138), assumed constant (template scale ~1.00 all clip)
cyclist.occlusion: behind the taxi frames 0-~22 (frames 0-11 only upper body visible); passes in front of the BMW frames ~25-37; lower wheels partly behind the Mercedes roof frames ~39-60; in front of the van frames ~55-71

pedestrian.motion_summary: walks left at ~2-4 px/frame image speed, feet row 777 -> 808 (approaching camera slowly)
pedestrian.reference_point: ref_x = mask centroid x; ref_y = estimated pelvis row = y1 - 0.47*height. (Biased once cut by the left edge, frames >= 22)
pedestrian.pixel_size: height head-top to feet 232 px (frame 0) .. 237-241 (frames 4-16) .. 247-253 (frames 20-32) (grows as he approaches); width 65-76 px (arm swing / stride)

events.event: clip start: taxi moving right, cyclist moving right (behind taxi), pedestrian walking left, van at rest
van starts moving (1 px shift 1->2) and then accelerates continuously to the end; all movers' displacement starts 1->2
cyclist's bicycle emerges in front of/right of the taxi's front (lower body visible from ~12)
taxi starts turning toward the camera (box width starts shrinking from ~490 px)
pedestrian's box reaches the left image edge (partly out of frame from here)
van rear passes behind the static pedestrian-signal box (frames 28-30 interpolated)
taxi image-x reaches its maximum (~819) - lateral image motion reverses (right -> slowly left)
taxi seen essentially head-on (narrowest box, 228 px); from here it drives straight towards the camera
pedestrian last visible (tiny sliver); gone from frame 46
cyclist starts overlapping the van's front in the image (cyclist in front)
clip end; all of taxi, van, cyclist still in frame and moving

contacts: no collisions or contacts between objects (overlaps are only in the image: depth ordering taxi < cyclist < van; Mercedes is in front of van wheels / cyclist wheels)
